name: Google Merchant Center
description: Google Merchant Center manages product data and eligibility across Google shopping surfaces, including processed catalog status and actionable item issues.
agentUseSummary: Connect one Google account through Relay-owned OAuth with the exact content scope and bind one accounts/{id} resource. Four stable-v1 wrappers list the first fifty accessible accounts, list the first fifty processed products for the bound account, read one explicit product, or run Relay's fixed fifty-row product-issues report. Relay blocks writes despite the provider scope, administration, arbitrary Merchant Query Language, exports, page tokens, automatic pagination, raw tools, service accounts, v1beta, and the legacy Content API.

blocked.label: Mutate catalog data
blocked.description: Product, input, inventory, data source, promotion, review, and conversion writes are blocked.

blocked.label: Administer Merchant Center
blocked.description: Account, subaccount, user, service, shipping, return, registration, and quota administration is blocked.

blocked.label: Query or export Merchant data
blocked.description: Arbitrary Merchant Query Language, filters, fields, tables, exports, page tokens, and automatic pagination are blocked.

blocked.label: Use legacy or raw Merchant APIs
blocked.description: Raw tools, service accounts, v1beta, Content API, batching, streaming, retries, and polling are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Four stable-v1 bounded reads run automatically while all writes, administration, arbitrary queries, legacy APIs, and pagination remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The exact scope, bound account, fixed query, fifty-row cap, stable-v1, redaction, and no-write boundaries remain enforced.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay must enable Merchant API, configure and verify the content scope, complete required developer registration, configure Railway staging credentials, and authorize an acceptance account. Those provider-console and environment actions are outside this worker task.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console task, configure the canonical Railway callback, API access, exact scope, developer registration, and staging credentials, then verify account binding, four wrappers, stable-v1 paths, fixed report, field redaction, refresh, rotation, revocation, disconnect, and quota/error mapping.
